# Maria

[Tabby’s Place](../codex/places.md#tabby-s-place)

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Place P29](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0029)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P50](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0050)</sub>

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Maria is driven by a desire for international travel, specifically hoping to visit Egypt and [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). She also possesses a compulsion to laugh at everything, regardless of how tragic or serious the situation may be.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Ezra P6](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0006), [v3 ch.Confidences P8](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0008)_

## Traits

- compulsively laughs at everything  <sub>[v3 ch.Ezra P6](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0006)</sub>

_Not yet known._

## Goals

- desires to travel to Europe  <sub>[v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018)</sub>
- to travel to Egypt  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P8](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0008)</sub>

## History

Maria lived with her aunt, Miss Tabby Linden, and helped manage Tabby's Place. Together with her aunt, she successfully arranged to rent their cottage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) for the school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

**Volume 3**

- regarded Aaron Linden as a good uncle  <sub>[v3 ch.Place P27](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0027)</sub>

## Relationships

### [Tabby](../character/tabby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--tabby.md)

Maria is the niece of Miss Tabby Linden, and the two live together at Tabby's Place. They act as traveling companions who stay overseas and eventually plan to go to Egypt together. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) meet both Maria and her aunt when successfully arranging to rent their cottage for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), +3 more_

- Comrade of — traveling companion staying overseas and going to Egypt together  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P50](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0050)</sub>
- Friend of — traveling companions staying overseas  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P50](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0050)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--nell-harcourt.md)

Maria and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are friends who interact surrounding Maria's cottage rental. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit Maria and her aunt to arrange renting their property for the school year. Later, Maria joins in sending a marriage gift and warm wishes to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), +2 more_

- Friend of — sent a marriage gift and good wishes together (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055)</sub>
